entries.en: Think you might ever go back to the Aldecaldos?

entries.en: Whatever you want. All you stand to miss is some real strong, real awful coffee.

entries.en: We need to think hard about how to handle the AV.

entries.en: The Raffens – we done with them?

entries.en: Oh no. The Shiv are cockroaches. One's never rid of them.
entries.ro: Ah, nu. Shiv sunt ca gândacii. Nu scapi niciodată de ei.

entries.en: But it should be quiet for a time. They'll need to gather their wits and dust themselves off.
entries.ro: Dar ar trebui să fie liniște o vreme. Au nevoie să-și vină în fire și să se scuture de praf.

entries.en: Look, about Nash...
entries.ro: Uite, despre Nash...

entries.en: So what's the plan?

entries.en: I won't talk about it.

entries.en: Well, Nash ain't likely to let Rocky Ridge slide, so…

entries.en: Are you worried about me all of a sudden? Or are you just afraid they'll come after us while we're trying to hit the AV?

entries.en: Sure, yeah, worried about you.

entries.en: I'm worried about you.

entries.en: That is not your concern anymore, V.

entries.en: I will manage. I have always managed. I'm serious.
entries.ro: Mă descurc. M-am descurcat mereu. Sunt serioasă.

entries.en: I just hope we'll finish our biz before you go out to get sweet revenge on the Raffens.
entries.ro: Sper doar să terminăm afacerile înainte să ieși să-ți iei dulcea răzbunare pe Raffens.

entries.en: You needn't be.
entries.ro: Nu e nevoie.

entries.en: Think I've seen through you enough to know what comes next. You're not about to let it go.
entries.ro: Te-am citit destul cât să știu ce urmează. N-o să lași baltă.

entries.en: Don't worry. I gave you my word. You'll talk to this Hellman of yours.
entries.ro: Nu-ți face griji. Ți-am dat cuvântul. O să vorbești cu Hellman-ul tău.

entries.en: And I will deal with my Raffens later. On my own.
entries.ro: Iar cu Raffens mă ocup mai târziu. Singură.

entries.en: So, Hellman. What's our plan?

entries.en: Well, first I need to sort out how to down the AV with one hand while taking out security with the other.
entries.ro: Păi, mai întâi trebuie să-mi dau seama cum dobor AV-ul cu o mână și scot securitatea cu cealaltă.

entries.en: Let's meet back here around midnight. Agreed?

entries.en: Uh, sure. Catch you later.
entries.ro: Ăă, sigur. Ne vedem mai târziu.

entries.en: All right, time we looked to my needs. What's the plan for Hellman?

entries.en: So, that package for Street – what was it?
entries.ro: Deci, pachetul pentru Street – ce era?

entries.en: Thanks, Noah.
entries.ro: Mulțumesc, Noah.

entries.en: You didn't peek? Baloperidol. Drugs for the cyberpsychos in our midst.
entries.ro: N-ai aruncat o privire? Baloperidol. Droguri pentru cyberpsychoii din mijlocul nostru.

entries.en: Yes. They have deals. With black clinics, rippers…
entries.ro: Da. Lucrează cu clinici negre, cu rippers…

entries.en: They trade in 'em?
entries.ro: Le și vând?

entries.en: Cheers. Lemme know if you need anything else.
entries.ro: Noroc. Zi-mi dacă mai vrei ceva.

entries.en: We done with the Raffens for good?

entries.en: Clan leader, Saul. What's his story?
entries.ro: Liderul clanului, Saul. Care e povestea lui?

entries.en: Listen, you and Saul... Who is he? Your leader or chieftain?
entries.ro: Ascultă, tu și Saul... Cine e el? Liderul sau șeful tău?

entries.en: Their leader.
entries.ro: Liderul lor.

entries.en: Were pretty keen to delta the hell out of there before he got back.
entries.ro: Eram destul de dornici să ne cărăm naibii de-acolo înainte să se întoarcă.

entries.en: Let's just say Saul wouldn't have been happy to see me.
entries.ro: Să zicem doar că lui Saul nu i-ar fi plăcut să mă vadă.

entries.en: What happened?
entries.ro: Ce s-a întâmplat?

entries.en: The reason we came to California was because he promised change for the Aldecaldos. He claimed we would turn over a new leaf.
entries.ro: Motivul pentru care am venit în California e că a promis schimbări pentru Aldecaldos. Zicea că o luăm de la capăt.

entries.en: But you saw it yourself. We got a handful of tents on a heap of sand. A hell of a promised land.
entries.ro: Dar ai văzut și tu. Avem o mână de corturi pe o grămadă de nisip. Țara făgăduinței, de zile mari.

entries.en: I wanted something different, better. But Saul's a damned coward. He'll be the end of the clan. I'm certain.
entries.ro: Am vrut ceva diferit, mai bun. Dar Saul e un laș al dracului. O să fie sfârșitul clanului. Sunt sigură.
entries.ro_m: Am vrut ceva diferit, mai bun. Dar Saul e un laș al dracului. O să fie sfârșitul clanului. Sunt sigur.

entries.en: The Aldecaldos – think you'll ever go back? I mean, not right now, but... someday?
entries.ro: Aldecaldos – crezi că o să te întorci vreodată? Adică nu acum, da' ... cândva?

entries.en: I don't rightly know... On the one hand, I don't have anyone outside the clan. Shit, I don't really know any other life.
entries.ro: Habar n-am... Pe de o parte, n-am pe nimeni în afara clanului. Căcat, nu cunosc altă viață.

entries.en: But on the other?
entries.ro: Și pe de altă parte?

entries.en: Without my clan, who am I? Who would I become if I stayed in Night City?
entries.ro: Fără clanul meu, cine sunt? Cine aș deveni dacă aș rămâne în Night City?

entries.en: Could make a fresh start. It's doable.

entries.en: Friends're hard to come by in Night City.

entries.en: Had to leave my clan, too.

entries.en: Ah yeah, I remember. Bakker family, right?

entries.en: Mhm. Then I came to Night City, saw my chance, took it...

entries.en: And?

entries.en: I wouldn't mind changing the subject now.

entries.en: She seems to bet her eddies on the right people. You'll work it out.
